data.name: Nabi
data.gender_notes: Nabi is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A name for prophets and messengers in Islam, derived from the Arabic root 'n-b-y', meaning 'to inform, to call, or to announce'. In Islamic history, Nabi refers to the prophets of Allah, including Prophet Muhammad (pbuh), Prophet Ibrahim (as), and Prophet Musa (as). The name Nabi carries the meaning “Prophet” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Nabi usually hope their child will grow to embody prophet and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that embodies the message of guidance and wisdom from Allah.
data.etymology: Nabi belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Prophet.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nabi total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_arabic.name: نبي
in_arabic.meaning: نبي تعني الرسول أو المرسل في اللغة العربية
in_arabic.long_meaning: نبي هو اسم مشتق من النبوة، وتعني الرسول أو المرسل في اللغة العربية. النبي هو الشخص الذي يتلقى الوحي من الله تعالى، ويتميز بالصدق والأمانة في نقل الرسالة الإلهية. ورد ذكر النبي في القرآن الكريم في عدة مواضع، منها قوله تعالى: "وَمَا أَرْسَلْنَا مِن قَبْلِكَ إِلَّا رَجُلًا نُّنَزِّلُ عَلَيْهِ الْوَحْيَ فَاسْأَلُوا أَهْلَ الذِّكْرِ إِن كُنتُمْ لَا تَعْلَمُونَ" (النحل: 43).

in_urdu.name: نبی
in_urdu.meaning: نبی کا مطلب ہوتا ہے رسول یا پیغمبر
in_urdu.long_meaning: نبی اسلامی تقویم میں ایک اہم اصطلاح ہے، جو اللہ تعالیٰ کے رسُول یا پیغمبر کو کہا جاتا ہے۔ نبی کا عمل نبوت کہلاتا ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے اللہ کی طرف سے موصول ہونے والی وحی کو لوگوں تک پہنچانا۔ قرآن مجید میں نبی کے حوالے سے کئی آیات موجود ہیں، جن میں اللہ تعالیٰ نبیوں کو اپنا خاص بندہ اور رسول بناتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: नबी
in_hindi.meaning: नबी का अर्थ है दूत या पैगंबर
in_hindi.long_meaning: नबी इस्लामी परंपरा में एक महत्वपूर्ण शब्द है, जो अल्लाह के दूत या पैगंबर को संदर्भित करता है। नबी की भूमिका होती है अल्लाह की ओर से प्राप्त होने वाली वाणी को लोगों तक पहुँचाना। कुरआन में नबी के संदर्भ में कई आयतें हैं, जिनमें अल्लाह नबियों को अपना विशेष सेवक और दूत बनाता है।

in_pashto.name: نبی
in_pashto.meaning: نبی د رسول یا پيغمبر معنی لري
in_pashto.long_meaning: نبی په اسلامي روایت کې یو مهم اصطلاح دی، چې د الله تعالی د رسول یا پیغمبر په معنا کارول کیږي. نبی دنده دا ده چې د الله لخوا ورته وحی شوي پیغام ته ورسوي خلکو ته. په قرآن کې د نبي په اړه ډیری آیتونه شته، چې پکښې الله تعالی نبیان خپل خاص بندګان او رسوالان جوړوي.

in_english.name: Nabi
in_english.meaning: Nabi means Prophet or Messenger in English
in_english.long_meaning: Nabi is a term used in Islamic tradition to refer to a prophet or messenger of Allah. The role of a nabi is to receive and convey the divine message to people. In the Quran, the term nabi is used to describe those who have been chosen by Allah to guide humanity. The Arabic root of the word nabi is 'n-b-ʾ', which means 'to call' or 'to announce'.

In daily life, it is used as a respectful and honorific title for the major figures in Islamic history and for the religious leaders in many Islamic countries. People often place great reverence towards the prophets and messengers of Allah, and addressing them as "Nabi" is a reflection of this respect.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name "Nabi" lies in its connection to the prophets and messengers of Allah. In Islamic belief, the prophets are considered to be close friends and messengers of Allah, sent to guide humankind towards the truth. The name "Nabi" reminds us of their divine mission and their important place in Islamic history and tradition. Moreover, it is a reminder of the importance of following the teachings and guidelines set by these prophets in order to live a righteous and godly life.

historical_references.reference: Muhammad ibn Abdullah, known as the Prophet Muhammad, is referred to as Nabi in Islamic tradition. He is considered the last prophet and founder of Islam, receiving divine revelations from Allah through the angel Gabriel between 610 and 632 CE.

The title Nabi (Prophet) is also used for other significant figures in Islamic history, such as Jesus, Moses, and Abraham. These prophets delivered messages from Allah to their respective communities, and their teachings form an essential part of Islamic belief and practice.
